text:
Total cost of the jacket and shoes:
$30 (jacket) + 2 × $20 (shoes) = $30 + $40 = $70

Money Sara already has and earns from babysitting:
$10 (savings) + 4 × $5 (babysitting) = $10 + $20 = $30

Remaining money needed:
$70 - $30 = $40

Number of times she must mow the lawn:
$40 / $4 = 10

ANSWER: 10
